snippet.title: [Trailer] CosmoFab - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CosmoFab is a factory automation game where you build massive production lines through mining, construction, manufacturing, and logistics.

Gather resources, construct facilities, optimize production chains,
and create your own industrial empire.

Search for "CosmoFab" on Steam or Epic Games Store.

■ Steam
store.steampowered.com/app/4776540/CosmoFab

■ Epic Games Store
store.epicgames.com/p/cosmofab-bb0c65

■ Release Date
Steam : July 2026
Epic Games Store : June 2026
